rows.question: A customer told me to skip Legal and promise roadmap functionality. Is that allowed?
rows.answer: No, it is not allowed to skip Legal and promise roadmap functionality. Sales Representatives must escalate to Legal before signature when a contract includes commitments to future roadmap functionality. Additionally, customer-specific contract commitments must not be promised without approval from Legal and Deal Desk. Promising roadmap commitments without approval is prohibited.

Escalation Triggers

Escalate to Legal before signature when a contract includes uncapped liability, customer audit rights broader than annual review, unusual data residency commitments, indemnity expansion, auto-renewal longer than one year, or commitments to future roadmap functionality.

When Sales receives a support issue, the Sales Representative should create or link the support case and include customer impact, account tier, urgency, and any promised follow-up. Sales should not run a parallel support process in private notes.
